newsitem.title: USA: Optical Sensors seeks market clearance.
newsitem.headline: Optical Sensors seeks market clearance.

text.p: Optical Sensors Inc said Monday it had filed with the Food and Drug Administration seeking clearance to market its new stand-alone arterial blood gas monitoring system in the U.S.
The company said it demonstrated a prototype of the device at a trade show in September in Glasgow.
"We anticipate launching the stand-alone system in European markets in early 1997, pending receipt of European regulatory approvals," said President Sam Humphries in a statement.
"Commercial distribution of the stand-alone system in the United States, subject to FDA clearance, is expected shortly thereafter," he said.
